N0.description: Degree-preserving endpoint-rewiring null already frozen in the ROUTE-I run.

N1.description: Directed double-edge swaps within the same route transition group. Each rewired edge must remain in the same within-group distance_norm quantile bin as the edge it replaces. Degree, layer transition, source confidence weight, and distance-stratum occupancy are preserved.

N2.description: Same directed degree/layer-preserving swap kernel as N1, but every proposed edge must remain in both its original distance_norm stratum and its original feature_similarity stratum. This is the harder local geometry+state control.

mechanism.viscosity_source_note: Frozen JHTDB Pilot-A adapter configuration; used only to scale the strain-based dissipation proxy. It does not alter ranks or ROUTE-I metrics.
